entities.name: Martti Lehtevä
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Martti Lehtevä was a Finnish boxer. He competed in the men's light welterweight event at the 1960 Summer Olympics. At the 1960 Summer Olympics, he lost to Willie Ludick of South Africa.
